# scan-configs

Scan configurations, NVT/family selection, preferences and generic configs.

- Toolset name: `scan-configs`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 16 (8 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_clone_config`

**Clone generic config** · mutating

Clone a generic config of any usage type. Returns the UUID of the copy.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_create_scan_config`

**Create scan config** · mutating

Create a scan configuration as a copy of an existing one (gvmd always copies; pick a base such as "Full and fast" or "Base"). Not idempotent: repeating the call creates duplicates.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_scan_config_id` | string | yes | UUID of the active scan config to copy from (required by gvmd) |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Scan config name |

### `openvas_delete_config`

**Delete generic config** · destructive

Delete a generic config of any usage type (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_delete_scan_config`

**Delete scan config** · destructive

Delete a scan configuration (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently). Fails with 409 if a task still uses it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_config`

**Get generic config** · read-only

Get one generic config by UUID (any usage type).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_get_scan_config`

**Get scan config** · read-only

Get one scan configuration by UUID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_get_scan_config_nvt`

**Get scan config NVT** · read-only

Get one NVT as selected by a scan configuration (404 if the config does not select it).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Scan config UUID |
| `oid` | string | yes | NVT OID |

### `openvas_get_scan_config_preference`

**Get scan config preference** · read-only

Get one configured preference of a scan configuration by name (scoped to an NVT with `nvt_oid`).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Scan config UUID |
| `name` | string | yes | Preference name |
| `nvt_oid` | string | no | NVT OID when the preference belongs to an NVT |

### `openvas_list_configs`

**List generic configs** · read-only

List configs across usage types (`scan`, `audit`, `policy`) in one catalog; filter with `usage_type`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |
| `usage_type` | string | no | Restrict to one usage type: scan, audit or policy |

### `openvas_list_scan_config_nvts`

**List scan config NVTs** · read-only

List the NVTs selected by a scan configuration, optionally restricted to one family. Pagination only (no filter expressions).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `family` | string | no | Restrict to one NVT family |
| `id` | string | yes | Scan config UUID |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_list_scan_config_preferences`

**List scan config preferences** · read-only

List the configured preferences of a scan configuration (scanner preferences, or one NVT's preferences when `nvt_oid` is given).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Scan config UUID |
| `nvt_oid` | string | no | Restrict to one NVT's preferences |

### `openvas_list_scan_configs`

**List scan configs** · read-only

List scan configurations (e.g. "Full and fast"). Returns summarized rows plus pagination; use openvas_get_scan_config for full details.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_set_scan_config_family_selection`

**Set scan config family selection** · destructive

Replace the family selection of a scan configuration: which NVT families are enabled, whether each grows with the feed, and whether all of its NVTs are selected. Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto_add_new_families` | boolean | no | Automatically add families that appear in future feed updates |
| `families` | array<object> | yes | Complete replacement family selection Each item: `all` (boolean, required): Select every NVT of the family; `growing` (boolean, required): Automatically include NVTs added to this family by feed updates; `name` (string, required): Family name, e.g. "Web Servers". |
| `id` | string | yes | Scan config UUID |

### `openvas_set_scan_config_nvt_selection`

**Set scan config NVT selection** · destructive

Replace the NVT selection of one family in a scan configuration with exactly the given OIDs. Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `family` | string | yes | Family whose selection is replaced |
| `id` | string | yes | Scan config UUID |
| `nvt_oids` | array<string> | yes | Complete replacement list of NVT OIDs for the family |

### `openvas_set_scan_config_preference`

**Set scan config preference** · destructive

Set (or, with `value` omitted, reset to default) one preference of a scan configuration. Scope to an NVT with `nvt_oid` for NVT preferences. Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Scan config UUID |
| `name` | string | yes | Preference name |
| `nvt_oid` | string | no | NVT OID when the preference belongs to an NVT |
| `value` | string | no | New value; omit to reset the preference to its default |

### `openvas_update_scan_config`

**Update scan config** · destructive

Rename or re-comment a scan configuration. Idempotent (PUT); fails with 409 if the config is predefined or in use.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the scan config to update |
| `name` | string | no |  |
